# DateTime.IsInCurrentMinute

```m
DateTime.IsInCurrentMinute(dateTime as any) as nullable logical
```

Indicates whether this datetime occurs during the current minute, as determined by the current date and time on the system.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/datetime-isincurrentminute)

| `dateTime` | `any` | no |
